🆕 New Listing (Posted: September 8, 2026)

Hanno City will hold a general competitive public auction for city-owned land on the condition that Hanno City Hall Building No. 2 is demolished and removed.

【Property for Sale】
Location: 94-25 Oaza Futanayanagi Shojinba and 371-2 Oaza Futanayanagi Hashiba (residential land, total 1,133.65 square meters)
Minimum sale price: ¥15,300,000
Bid security deposit: ¥2,295,000

【Buildings to be Demolished】
Hanno City Hall Building No. 2 (House numbers 371-2 and 371-2-2)
• 371-2: Reinforced concrete and steel structure, 4 stories with 1 basement level, total floor area 1,414.47 square meters
• 371-2-2: Steel structure single-story building, floor area 207.77 square meters
(Note: Registered information and existing structures may differ)

【Site Viewing and Document Review】
Application period: September 15 (Tuesday) through September 30, 2026 (Reiwa 8)
Scheduled viewing dates: October 5 (Monday), 6 (Tuesday), or 7 (Wednesday), 2026
Apply to: Asset Management Division (sisankeiei@city.hanno.lg.jp)

【Question Submission】
Submission period: October 8 (Thursday) through October 16, 2026 (Friday)
Scheduled answer date: October 27, 2026 (Tuesday)
Submit to: Asset Management Division (sisankeiei@city.hanno.lg.jp)

【Auction】
Bid participation application: November 2 (Monday) through November 13, 2026 (Friday) (excluding weekends and holidays, 9:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; postal submissions must arrive by deadline)
Auction date and time: November 20, 2026 (Friday), 2:00 p.m.
Location: Bid Room, 2nd Floor, Hanno City Hall Main Building (1-1 Oaza Futanayanagi)

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/shisankeieika/shisannkeiei/14356.html
summary: ℹ️ Public Auction for City-Owned Land with Building Demolition Requirement (Hanno City Hall Building No. 2)
